title: Monetization Health Score: A Ten-Minute Diagnostic
meta_description: Score your monetization across pricing, paywall, collection and store economics in ten minutes. Shows its formula and its Indian defaults.

visuals.alt: Six inputs the monetization health score checks: store commission rates, Apple's core technology commission, UPI Autopay mandate success, the share of companies on hybrid pricing, the share of spend still on seats, and the all-in range for international payment costs from India, each row carrying its source and verification date
visuals.caption: What the score checks, and the published figure behind each. Verified 30 September 2026.

faq.q: What does the monetization health score measure?
faq.a: Four things: whether the price has been tested, whether the paywall is placed against a known value moment, whether collection is instrumented, and whether store and payment costs are in the model. Each scores separately.
It needs four or five numbers you already have, entered in the browser. Nothing is submitted, nothing is stored, and no email is requested before the result appears.
Any dimension scoring zero matters more than the total. A product with excellent pricing and uninstrumented collection is losing revenue it cannot see, and a total score would average that away.

primary.label: Get a monetization health score review

unique_value_statement: Scores collection and store economics as separate dimensions rather than folding them into a single monetization total, and ships Indian payment defaults, so a zero on an invisible dimension surfaces instead of averaging away.
